market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool under Arne Slot are a dominant force, performing at league-leading levels in 2024-25. Historically they have finished top 4 in 4 of the last 5 seasons, and their squad depth and consistency suggest a very high probability of top 4 in 2025-26. The market price implies a significantly lower chance than is realistic.
